The '''Delle system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It was located between the [[Neuvia system/Legends|Neuvia]] and [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa systems]] and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]] on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which served as the dividing line between the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained massive [[Agriworld/Legends|farm worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the terrestrial celestial body [[Delle II]].<ref name="Journal3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Delle system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
